# WC9 · Patient 360 · Ảnh trước / sau

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · tab · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#photos`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `clinic.js › photos(p)`: Before / After Studio inside Patient 360; the angle select `#studio-view`, the mode button ("Đặt cạnh nhau" / "So sánh trượt") and "＋ Thêm ảnh" (`data-action=capture`).
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-service` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `careNav=cashier` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"photos\"]"}; it must show `#studio-view`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients/[id]` · status: **built (U3)** · U step: U3
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients/[id]` "Patient 360" (owner U1, U3); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`, `src/components/ops/patient/patient-360-view.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/consult-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/plan-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/session-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/photos-tab.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/patient-tabs.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/session-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/plan-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/media-upload.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/patients/[id]/page.tsx`

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Chưa có ảnh upload ở góc này. Hai ảnh dưới đây là minh họa tổng hợp. Chưa kiểm định căn chỉnh ảnh; bác sĩ kiểm tra điều kiện chụp trước khi so sánh."
- (old web notice) "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- (old web notice) "Phóng to Cùng góc khai báo · không tự căn chỉnh"
- (old web notice) "Metadata: vùng Mặt; góc Chính diện; mốc buổi minh họa; đồng ý chăm sóc: có ghi nhận. Không suy ra hiệu quả y khoa từ các ảnh minh họa."
- (old web notice) "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- "Chưa kiểm định căn chỉnh ảnh; bác sĩ kiểm tra điều kiện chụp trước khi so sánh." (notice of the studio).
- Illustrative photos do not score efficacy: the faces are marked "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP".

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
- Canvas: the old studio-note notice (zoom slider + chip "Cùng góc khai báo · không tự căn chỉnh") is drawn as one info box holding the "Phóng to" range field and the chip, so the combined sentence is exempted through demo_data. Only the default "Đặt cạnh nhau" mode is drawn; the "So sánh trượt" mode adds a "Vị trí so sánh" slider and a "Trước ← → Sau" chip.
